title: 1 Bedroom/1 Bath Cozy 6th Floor Retreat w/Balcony
description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place near downtown Nashville.  Step into the heart of Music City and let this chic one-bedroom, one-bath apartment be your private get away. You'll be minutes from the city's best attractions like Broadway, Music City Center, and Bridgestone arena. After a day exploring, settle into this cozy apartment and relax on the balcony with a view of downtown. It's thoughtfully designed for comfort, offering all the essentials you need.

The space
1 Bedroom/1 Bath apartment with Queen bed and a sleeper sofa. Sleeps up to 4 guests, with easy elevator access. Fully Stocked Kitchen to meet all of your traveling needs with a washer/dryer. Onsite amenities available to guests during your stay.
